text:
maria-cs: Heads-up — WidgetCo just escalated. Their per-model throughput graphs in the Console are showing flat zeros starting ~2026-03-14T22:00Z. They can still call the API and embeddings are returning; only the per-model QPS lines are gone.

observability-bot: Alert: 3 dashboards (widgetco/model-qps, widgetco/replica-qps, platform/per-model) showing no series for 'redwood_per_model_qps_total' — last scrape 2026-03-14T22:05:12Z.

alex-eng-platform: On it. Any recent metrics or exporter changes deployed yesterday evening? :thinking_face:

priya-support: We deployed a metrics-exporter relabel rule at ~2026-03-14T21:48Z to normalize model tags (model -> model_name_v2). It was intended to dedupe variants.

sam-oncall: That explains it — dashboards are still querying the old label. Can someone paste the PromQL you're using in the panels?

maria-cs: Panels are using: `sum(rate(redwood_per_model_qps_total[5m])) by (model)` — customer confirmed they didn't change anything on their side.

alex-eng-platform: Quick checks from the exporter host: exporter is up and emitting metrics, but label 'model' is absent and instead 'model_name_v2' exists. Example series snippet from /metrics endpoint:
```
redwood_per_model_qps_total{model_name_v2=\"gpt-small\",job=\"exporter\",instance=\"10.2.4.12:9100\"} 1234
```
No series with `model=` present.

priya-support: Oof. That relabel rule should have been backward-compatible. Looks like the rewrite replaced the label outright.

sam-oncall: Quick remediation options: 1) update Grafana/console panels to query the new label (short term), 2) revert the relabeling and restore the `model` label (fastest to restore customer dashboards). For WidgetCo SLA risk I'd prefer rollback.

maria-cs: Customer is on a call and needs visibility restored ASAP. Please proceed with the fastest safe path.

alex-eng-platform: Rolling back the relabel change now. Pushing config and will restart exporter. I will post restart logs.

observability-bot: Deployment event: metrics-exporter-config reverted by alex-eng-platform at 2026-03-14T22:18:45Z (deploy-id 1839991145).

alex-eng-platform: Restart logs:
```
2026-03-14T22:19:01Z exporter starting
2026-03-14T22:19:04Z scrape_success=1 target=10.2.4.12:9100
2026-03-14T22:19:05Z emitted series redwood_per_model_qps_total{model=\"gpt-small\",...}
```
Prometheus now showing `model` label again.

sam-oncall: Can someone refresh the dashboards for WidgetCo? Grafana should pick up series automatically, but might need cache bust.

maria-cs: Refreshed. Customer confirms per-model lines are back and QPS numbers look correct. They say "thanks, much better" on the call. :tada:

priya-support: Leaving a note on the support ticket: rollback complete, graphs restored, advised engineering to make relabeling backward-compatible.

jess-product: Follow-up suggestion: add a CI/integration test that runs a sanity PromQL against our dashboards after any metrics-schema change (e.g., expect per-model panel to return >0 for known traffic). Filing PROD-1029.

alex-eng-platform: Agreed. I'll add a compatibility layer in the exporter so both `model` and `model_name_v2` exist until dashboards are migrated. Also adding dashboard queries that fallback to either label.

sam-oncall: Filing follow-up infra ticket INFRA-3421 to track long-term changes and owner.

maria-cs: Closing loop with WidgetCo and marking the escalation resolved. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

observability-bot: Note: incident-free rollback completed, no data loss detected.

maria-cs: Closing thread — will update the support ticket with notes and reference PROD-1029/INFRA-3421.
